g.text: Figure 5: Structural Comparison: Modular Monolith (3Dex) vs. Microservices Architecture
Shared Runtime: 1 OS Process & 1 CI/CD Pipeline
Data Boundary: Single Relational DB with Foreign Keys
Transactionality: Native ACID via BEGIN / COMMIT
Decoupled Runtime: N Independent Deployments & Pipelines
Inter-Module Comm: Remote RPC / REST / Message Queues
